## Product Summary

**Reviralis Complete** is a 41-ingredient whole-body wellness capsule manufactured in a USDA-certified facility. It is non-GMO and stimulant-free.

**The 4-Step Daily Balance Reset Method:**
1. Stop the Trigger (7 neuro/stress ingredients): Bacopa Monnieri, N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine, Phosphatidylserine, Vitamin B5, Magnesium, Choline, DHA
2. Support the Wear You Don't See (12 metabolic/vitamin ingredients): Cinnamon Bark Extract, B6, Niacin, Riboflavin, Thiamine, Folate, Biotin, Vitamin E, Copper, Manganese, Calcium, Potassium
3. Seal the Exit Points (10 antioxidant/immune ingredients): Licorice Root Extract, Olive Leaf Powder, Green Tea EGCG, Grape Seed Extract, Grapefruit Seed Extract, Vitamin C, Vitamin D, Vitamin A, Zinc, Selenium
4. Future-Proof Your Body (9 longevity ingredients): Chromium, DMAE Bitartrate, Inositol, Glutamic Acid, Iron, Molybdenum, Boron, Vanadyl Sulfate, Bilberry Fruit Extract
